string.name: desc
string.value: Uses a blast of powerful energy to strike a monster. If there are other monsters around the affected monster, they will also be affected by this potent ball of energy. Only available when your #cenergy is fully charged#.\nRequired Skill: #cEnergy Charge Lv. 1#
